name: benchtab
description: A local-first Chrome research workbench for following, calculating, and recording experiments.

scripts.build:newtab: npm run assets:generate && vite build && node scripts/generate-manifest.mjs newtab && node scripts/validate-extension.mjs newtab
scripts.build:dashboard: npm run assets:generate && vite build && node scripts/generate-manifest.mjs dashboard && node scripts/validate-extension.mjs dashboard
scripts.release:verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run package:chrome
